screening.reason: Inclusion 2,3: resting-state fMRI (plus phenotypic/QC modalities) diagnostic prediction (ASD vs TC) on two ABIDE I-derived multimodal benchmarks using a graph-learning deep model.

evidence_spans.text: We apply DeepASD to the benchmarking Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) data with four modalities.
evidence_spans.claim: DeepASD is evaluated on ABIDE data with four modalities.

evidence_spans.text:
The dataset includes 871 subjects
(468 TC and 403 ASD subjects). We follow (Parisot, 2017) [19] for
the dataset settings and preprocessing.
evidence_spans.claim: ABIDE A cohort: 871 subjects, 403 ASD, 468 TC, following Parisot 2017 setup.

evidence_spans.text:
ABIDE B, encompassing
949 subjects, adheres to the settings outlined by (Wang, 2020)
[10]. This cohort includes 419 individuals diagnosed with ASD and
530 TC subjects.
evidence_spans.claim: ABIDE B cohort: 949 subjects, 419 ASD, 530 TC, following Wang 2020 setup.

evidence_spans.text:
The dataset integrates three brain atlases (CC200,
AAL - Automated Anatomical Labeling, and DOS - Dosenbach160)
evidence_spans.claim: ABIDE B fMRI features are derived from three atlases: CC200, AAL, Dosenbach160.

evidence_spans.text: For a fair comparison, all data are preprocessed using the Conﬁgurable Pipeline for the Analysis of Connectomes (C-PAC) based on the preprocessed fMRI datasets [22].
evidence_spans.claim: Preprocessing pipeline is C-PAC via the Preprocessed Connectomes Project.

evidence_spans.text:
we performed a 10-
fold stratiﬁed cross-validation strategy on the two datasets.

All experiments were conducted with a 10-fold cross-validation to divide the dataset into training and test sets, with 10% of the training set randomly selected as the validation set. Ultimately, the training, validation, and test sets were non-overlapping.
evidence_spans.claim: Train/validation/test sets were kept non-overlapping within the 10-fold CV scheme.

evidence_spans.text: The model achieved the following performance metrics, presented in mean ± standard deviation format, on the ABIDE A dataset: accuracy (ACC) of 87.38 ± 2.87%, area under curve (AUC) of 92.76 ± 4.00%, speciﬁcity (SEN) of 88.35 ± 6.83%, and sensitivity (SPE) of 86.51 ± 8.41%.
evidence_spans.claim: Main ABIDE A result: accuracy 87.38%, AUC 92.76%.

evidence_spans.text:
showing an improvement of 13.25% in
accuracy, 7.69% in AUC-ROC, and 17.10% in speciﬁcity.
evidence_spans.claim: DeepASD improves over baselines by 13.25% accuracy, 7.69% AUC-ROC, 17.10% specificity.

evidence_spans.text: In the population-gcn [19] study, the construction of patient-patient relational graphs was based on demographic information, speciﬁcally sex and site.
evidence_spans.claim: Site is used as a demographic feature for patient-graph construction in a cited baseline approach (population-GCN), contextualising how site information is incorporated.

evidence_spans.text: The ABIDE dataset is available from ref. [21], and the preprocessed dataset ABIDE A and ABIDE B are provided with the paper.
evidence_spans.claim: Data availability: ABIDE A/B preprocessed datasets provided with the paper.

evidence_spans.text: An interactive code base for DeepASD implementation is available at https:// codeocean.com/capsule/6043886/tree.
evidence_spans.claim: Analysis code publicly available via Code Ocean.

assessments.support: Both cohorts fully specified: "The dataset includes 871 subjects (468 TC and 403 ASD subjects)" and "This cohort includes 419 individuals diagnosed with ASD and 530 TC subjects" (ABIDE B), each tied to a named published preprocessing/selection protocol (Parisot 2017 / Wang 2020).
"all data are preprocessed using the Conﬁgurable Pipeline for the Analysis of Connectomes (C-PAC)" and three named atlases (CC200, AAL, Dosenbach160) for ABIDE B.
ASD/TC labels taken from the ABIDE phenotype file via the cited prior preprocessing protocols; the specific diagnostic instrument/criteria are not elaborated in this paper.

"we performed a 10-
fold stratiﬁed cross-validation strategy" with "training, validation, and test sets were non-overlapping", and performance reported as mean±SD across folds with a two-sample t-test versus baselines; site is used only as a demographic feature within the graph-construction model rather than ignored, though no leave-site-out evaluation is reported.

risk_of_bias.summary: Well-specified cohorts (both following previously published ABIDE A/B protocols), pipeline, atlases, and a leakage-aware stratified 10-fold CV with non-overlapping splits; residual concern is that site is used as a model feature rather than evaluated with a leave-site-out design, and the diagnostic label source is not elaborated.

charting.model_category: Graph neural network (multimodal adversarial-regularized graph learning)
charting.specific_algorithms: DeepASD (multimodal adversarial-regularized encoder + adaptive patient similarity graphs + GNN classifier), compared against 8 baselines including population-GCN, AIMAFE and other multimodal/deep models
charting.validation_methodology: 10-fold stratified cross-validation with non-overlapping train/validation/test splits; two-sample t-test for significance versus baselines

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Diagnostic prediction study; two ABIDE I-derived multimodal benchmarks, ABIDE A (871 subjects: 403 ASD, 468 TC) and ABIDE B (949 subjects: 419 ASD, 530 TC)
narrative_row.methods: C-PAC-preprocessed resting-state fMRI connectivity (CC200/AAL/Dosenbach160 atlases) combined with phenotypic and QC modalities, classified with a multimodal adversarial-regularized graph learning model (DeepASD) using patient similarity graphs and a GNN classifier; evaluated with 10-fold stratified, non-overlapping cross-validation
narrative_row.outcomes: DeepASD outperformed 8 state-of-the-art baselines (accuracy 87.38% / AUC 92.76% on ABIDE A; accuracy 88.09% / AUC 93.59% on ABIDE B), an improvement of 13.25% accuracy, 7.69% AUC-ROC and 17.10% specificity over the best baseline; ablation confirmed fMRI as the most informative single modality, with other modalities adding further gains
narrative_row.key_limitations: Diagnostic label source/instrument not elaborated; site is incorporated as a demographic feature for graph construction rather than evaluated with a leave-site-out scheme despite the known multi-site heterogeneity of ABIDE
narrative_row.relevance_notes: Both cohorts are explicitly reconstructible by citation to previously published preprocessing protocols (Parisot 2017, Wang 2020), and both preprocessed datasets plus analysis code are released with the paper.
